outcome: maternal outcomes in labor and delivery
fetal outcomes in labor and delivery
admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 72 term, singleton, low-risk pregnant women who received intravenous ferric carboxymaltose treatment in the third trimester, compared with 72 pregnant women who were anemic at the time of delivery
finding: Correcting anemia with intravenous ferric carboxymaltose in the third trimester did not significantly affect neonatal outcomes but reduced maternal morbidity.
